summary.headline: Venus and Mercury in Terms
summary.text: Astrological delineations for Venus in Mars’s, her own, and Mercury’s terms and in a common sign, describing disputes, sorrow, marriage, offspring, honor, prefectures, writing, wealth, and dreams. Chapter XXV begins the signification of Mercury in his own or others’ terms, including travel, science, royal writing, public favor, and good dreams.
